description: The only opened contemporary report located so far attributes attendance and police-handling details for the Madrid January 23 march to sources from the Government Delegation in Madrid; independent confirmation has not yet been read.
required_followup: Search and open a distinct contemporary report or primary record; compare authorship and underlying information before treating it as independent corroboration.

description: The shared baseline record says the latest official event files, current schema/universe, and additional Coding Procedure are unresolved; this dossier remains a candidate-only extension.
required_followup: Coordinator to continue the documented baseline access and compatibility work; do not assign official identifiers or merge candidates.

description: A CSIF page announces Canary Islands public-administration work stoppages on 11 and 15 January but does not establish actual participation, numbers, or a public assembly.
required_followup: Search contemporaneous regional media or official records for execution and any public gathering; do not code a protest event from the announcement alone.

description: A January 20 advance report lists a Madrid travel-agency march planned for 21 January, but follow-up coverage has not established whether it occurred or whether 50 people attended.
required_followup: Find a post-event source for Madrid that verifies occurrence, human turnout, organizer and state-directed demands; keep the physical date null until occurrence is evidenced.

description: A January 21 report confirms a car march in Valencia, but gives no human turnout; vehicle counts cannot establish the required 50-person threshold.
required_followup: Find a direct or independent human attendance estimate; preserve the event as pending_threshold until the number is supported.

description: A Catalan-language search result titles a university-student protest about the education crisis and university rectors, but the exact 3CatInfo page returned an actual 403; date, turnout, organizer and state/policy target are unverified.
required_followup: Search a distinct contemporaneous source or organizer record without retrying or bypassing the blocked page; retain the lead as unverified unless event details are established.

description: The first Basque-language query returned primarily out-of-window material; the one opened article is dated 23 April 2021, so this search did not establish January coverage.
required_followup: Use additional Basque-language terms and date windows or a distinct local source; do not infer absence from this low-precision result set.

description: MODEPEN's archive and two event pages list a Vigo concentration on 4 January and a Lugo gathering on 15 January, but do not explicitly state that either was held; physical start dates remain null.
required_followup: Find contemporaneous reporting, photographs with dates, or a post-event organizer account that confirms each gathering took place before assigning physical start dates.

description: MODEPEN's January event listings give no human attendance for the Lugo or Vigo gatherings; the 50-person threshold remains unknown.
required_followup: Seek direct or independent attendance evidence for each city; do not infer numbers from the event archive or campaign size.

description: The MODEPEN listings link separate city/date actions around public pensions and the gender gap, plus a multi-site call explicitly marked suspended on 25 January; the relation among physical episodes is unresolved.
required_followup: Review original episode rules and campaign coordination before linking or splitting; preserve the tentative episode key and separate physical dates.

description: El Salto announced the MATS demonstration and Telemadrid confirms that it occurred on 22 January, but the latter gives only qualitative attendance and no numeric lower bound; the 50-person threshold remains unverified.
required_followup: Search distinct contemporaneous reporting or a post-event organizer record for actual human turnout, and keep eligibility pending until the threshold is supported.

description: A community-association page reproduces the report of a 24 January Burgos business-sector demonstration and credits Diario de Burgos; the more-than-1,500 estimate is attributed to organizers, with no independent confirmation located.
required_followup: Locate the original Diario de Burgos report or an independent contemporaneous account and compare the attendance attribution; preserve the current figure as one organizer estimate.

description: The January 18 Burgos hospitality gathering and its 300-person figure are visible in a community page that credits burgosnoticias.com; the original item or independent corroboration has not yet been located.
required_followup: Locate the original burgosnoticias.com report or an independent contemporary account, preserve the 300 figure as one report's estimate, and keep event-specific state responses unknown until evidenced.

description: A 19 January report announces a TERE concentration in Hospital La Paz's plaza during a 21 January emergency-service strike, but no post-event evidence establishes that the public gathering occurred. The 157-to-3 figure is a strike-authorization vote, not turnout.
required_followup: Find a contemporaneous post-event report or organizer account establishing whether the concentration occurred and its human attendance; do not use strike votes as participants.

description: The 31 January coordinated car-convoy action has an approximate human estimate for Santander but no national attendee total; the multi-city total is unknown.
required_followup: Seek independent human attendance estimates by city or an explicit national estimate. Do not sum vehicles, affected workers, or city locations.

description: Sources disagree on the city count and reported time window for the 31 January convoy: RTVE/Europa Press lists 27 locations, while USO reports Cantabria plus 27 other cities. InfoLibre/MadridActual report 11:00–12:00; USO reports a Santander route ending at 13:00.
required_followup: Compare source-level origin, site coverage and time definitions; preserve the conflict until an independent direct account resolves it. Do not infer a national end time.

description: The 14 January public-employees concentrations are reported in Pamplona and about 40 cities, but no human attendance count is given; the 50-person threshold is unresolved.
required_followup: Find human turnout evidence for an individual gathering or the national call; location count and workforce totals are not attendance.

description: The 31 January national reports have a shared or uncertain reporting chain: RTVE identifies Europa Press in its byline, MadridActual attributes its article to MA/EP, INAP explicitly republishes RTVE, and Diario de Navarra credits Europa Press. Opened infoLibre paragraphs materially match the RTVE/Europa Press story, although its page credits only the photo to Europa Press; do not infer text origin from photo credit alone.
required_followup: Compare the article text and bylines against source originals, obtain distinct local or organizer reporting, and do not count agency republications or copied text as independent corroboration.

description: A Teruel municipal-document URL surfaced in follow-up search but its web open returned Internal Error; its body was not read and the search-only lead is not used to establish an event.
required_followup: If needed, recover only by an ordinary request to the same public URL after the web error; otherwise retain as search-only and do not use its snippet as evidence.

description: The 14 January concentration is supported by one Diario de Navarra account reproduced in a CCOO-hosted PDF; no separate original-page copy or independent contemporaneous report was located in this follow-up.
required_followup: Locate the original Diario de Navarra item or a distinct contemporaneous account, and verify which locations and organizations it covered.

description: Cross-month searches surfaced a 12 December 2020 Aragón protest and a planned 15 February 2021 nationwide action concerning public-employment temporality. Their bodies were not opened; these date-specific leads do not establish a physical episode continuing into or out of January.
required_followup: If unit-boundary review requires it, open the two exact public pages and verify whether these were separate one-day actions. Do not represent the repeated campaign as a continuous physical gathering.

description: The 29 January UAM student protest is confirmed, but the report supplies no student attendance number; whether the gathering reached 50 is unresolved.
required_followup: Find an organizer or independent contemporary human attendance estimate; do not use unrelated page content as turnout.

description: The immediate target of the UAM student protest was the public university Rectorate, while Telemadrid says the Community of Madrid and rectors jointly agreed on in-person exams. The boundary between university administration and domestic state-policy demand should be calibrated against the original coding rules.
required_followup: Review the original state-target rule and, if needed, locate the students' own statement clarifying which authority they petitioned.

description: The 30 January environmental action was coordinated across multiple cities. The organization report says several activists in Seville but hundreds across many cities, without per-site counts; threshold eligibility depends on preserving the national call as one multi-site unit rather than splitting locations.
required_followup: Check the original multi-site event rule, obtain site-level counts and full location list, and retain separate uncertainty about whether the Seville component alone cleared 50.

description: The farm-protest query surfaced prominent January actions dated 2020, including a UPA/UGT schedule and a retrospective ASAJA article in its January 2021 issue. These are not January 2021 events; no 2021 farm action was verified through these leads.
required_followup: Continue local agricultural-source discovery if needed; do not carry 2020 physical actions into this unit or infer no January 2021 farm protest from these search results.
